resource.title: [Jules Task 14] CDP Portal Navigator State Machine & Resiliency Suite
resource.prompt:
Create a resilient mock-based CDP navigator unit test suite in tests/test_cdp_navigator_resilience.js for scripts/lib/navigate_oca.js:
1. Test portal auto-navigation state machine when DOM elements load slowly (>10s timeout recovery).
2. Test handling of WebLogic SSO popups, unexpected modal dialogs, and navigation redirects.
3. Test graceful WebSocket reconnect when Chrome DevTools Protocol port 9222 drops temporarily.
4. Ensure all tests pass and integrate into npm run test:all.

gitPatch.suggestedCommitMessage:
Add CDP navigator resilience test suite and fix fallback RAG bug

- Created `tests/test_cdp_navigator_resilience.js` to simulate slow DOM loading, login timeouts, SSO popups, and WebSocket reconnects for CDP port 9222.
- Integrated the new resilience test suite into `test:all` script in `package.json`.
- Fixed a bug in `scripts/lib/notebook_query_utils.js` where the RAG fallback logic was not cleanly triggering when the `nlm` mock CLI returned a "No response" empty answer in Chaos test environments.
